description: Bind the exact Codex Stop hook assistant message through the Epistesys 7.0.0-beta.1 packaged binary; no user or mutation authority is created.

hooks.command: root=$PLUGIN_ROOT; data=$PLUGIN_DATA; if [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" ]; then root=$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; data=$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA; fi; PLUGIN_ROOT="$root" PLUGIN_DATA="$data" sh "$root/hooks/run-stop-hook.sh"
